audience: warehouse teams that check stock and shipments in Logiwa

useCases.title: Find stock lines that are running low
useCases.text: List the inventory lines at or below a quantity threshold. Use the page index to read the next page.

useCases.title: Find shipment orders that are past due
useCases.text: List shipment orders with an expected date in a range that have not shipped. The check uses the UTC date.

useCases.title: Compare orders placed with orders shipped
useCases.text: Count the orders placed and the orders shipped in a date range, for all warehouses or for one warehouse.
